newsitem.title: JAPAN: EPA says has not changed its view of Japan economy.
newsitem.headline: EPA says has not changed its view of Japan economy.

text.p: Japan's Economic Planning Agency (EPA) has not changed its assessment of the economy in its monthly economic report for January, EPA Vice Minister Shimpei Nukaya said on Friday.
In the December report, the EPA said it had moved "half a step forward" in its assessment of Japan's gradual recovery following a torpid summer.
Nukaya said the economy was gradually recovering, despite the dramatic fall in Tokyo stock prices.
"Putting aside the fall in stock prices, business conditions at the moment confirm the economy is still recovering," he said.

"Employment and the jobs-to-applicants ratio have improved, and the forecasts for production in December and January show rises. Looking at these factors, we can see a recovery led by the private sector," he added.
